title: Jet-engine Honda car driven to Los Alamos
place_text: Los Alamos, New Mexico; El Mirage Dry Lake, California

tellings.quote: took my wife's little Honda, built a jet engine from scratch and

plain: Bob Lazar, an engineer and a guest of the podcast host Jesse Michels, says that around 1982 he took his wife's small Honda car and fitted it with a jet engine he built from scratch. He says he drove it to Los Alamos, a US government weapons lab in New Mexico, and ran it at El Mirage Dry Lake in California. He tells it as a sign of the hands-on skill behind his later claims.
